Product details

LC Waikiki is a multi-cultural fashion brand which has continuously grown in the global market over the last 17 years. LC Waikiki today has a brand range that includes clothes and accessories for men, women and children of all ages, including babies, style-aware individuals and families. The brand accompanies itself with a distinctive methodology – high-quality clothes at great value. From close-fitting, stylish knitwear for men, to fashionable shoes and slippers for young girls, LC Waikiki has exactly what you need, when you need it.
